_about: Template for the local, untracked config/callers.json — copy it there and replace the sample caller ids with the threads this workspace actually runs. A caller is the named thread doing the work, claimed at the wrapper seams (--caller flag, or $COLAB_CALLER for drivers) and validated against this registry; the machinery callers (panel, standing, test, lease) are code constants and never listed here. A caller may carry one lane suffix (alpha-thread:lane-1) validated against its registered base.
